amount_text: A$4.25B (~US$2.98B); SMBC lead global coordinator (with HSBC and UOB), 32 lenders in all
title_en: SMBC-led banks lend AirTrunk A$4.25B green loan for Sydney SYD3 campus
title_zh: 三井住友银行牵头向 AirTrunk 提供 42.5 亿澳元绿色贷款，用于悉尼 SYD3 园区
summary_en: Blackstone-owned AirTrunk secured an A$4.25B (~US$3B) green loan from 32 lenders, led by SMBC, HSBC and UOB, to keep building its 400 MW-plus SYD3 hyperscale campus in Western Sydney, due by mid-2028. It lifts AirTrunk's committed debt to about A$38.4B.
summary_zh: 黑石旗下 AirTrunk 从以三井住友银行、汇丰和大华银行牵头的 32 家贷款机构获得 42.5 亿澳元（约 30 亿美元）绿色贷款，用于继续建设西悉尼逾 400 兆瓦的 SYD3 超大规模园区，预计 2028 年中完工。AirTrunk 已承诺债务融资总额因此升至约 384 亿澳元。

amount_text: ~$43.5B first lien (about 69% of the $63B total), per two sources cited by Reuters; arranged by Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley for syndication
title_en: Bank of America, Citi and Morgan Stanley arrange ~$43.5B first lien for Anthropic chip SPV
title_zh: 美国银行、花旗和摩根士丹利为 Anthropic 芯片 SPV 安排约 435 亿美元第一留置权贷款
summary_en: Bank of America, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley are arranging the first-lien debt of a $63B financing for a newly formed SPV that buys Broadcom AI accelerators and networking gear and leases them to Anthropic, with Broadcom giving residual value support. The WSJ reported that Broadcom agreed to higher rates and more loss protection after some banks wavered.
summary_zh: 美国银行、花旗和摩根士丹利正为一笔 630 亿美元融资安排第一留置权债务：新设特殊目的实体用这笔资金购买博通 AI 加速器和网络设备并租给 Anthropic，博通提供余值担保支持。据《华尔街日报》报道，在部分银行动摇后，博通同意提高利率并加强损失保护。

amount_text: Second-lien amount not disclosed; the $63B total minus the reported ~$43.5B first lien leaves ~$19.5B (early October reports: $18B junior tranche, ~$9B from Blackstone funds)
title_en: Blackstone provides second-lien debt in $63B Anthropic chip financing
title_zh: 黑石在 Anthropic 630 亿美元芯片融资中提供第二留置权债务
summary_en: Blackstone is the sole provider of the committed second-lien tranche of the $63B financing for a new SPV that buys Broadcom AI accelerators and networking gear and leases them to Anthropic, Reuters reported on 26 October 2026. Banks hold the larger first lien (separate edge).
summary_zh: 据路透社 2026 年 10 月 26 日报道，黑石是这笔 630 亿美元融资中已承诺第二留置权档的唯一提供方；新设特殊目的实体用这笔资金购买博通 AI 加速器和网络设备并租给 Anthropic。规模更大的第一留置权由银行提供（另列一条）。

subkind: 144A notes funding a GPU lessor (A2 mezzanine tranche)
amount_text: $4B of the A2 (mezzanine) tranche of the 144A notes that fund the Apollo-managed lessor behind the ~$40B SpaceX GPU lease (Bloomberg); size of the whole note programme not stated
term: Notes fund ~5-5.25-year GPU leases starting H1 2027
title_en: PIMCO buys $4B of notes funding SpaceX's Apollo GPU lessor
title_zh: PIMCO 认购 40 亿美元票据，为 SpaceX 的阿波罗 GPU 出租实体融资
summary_en: Bloomberg reported that PIMCO bought $4B of the A2 (mezzanine) tranche of the 144A notes issued by the Apollo-managed entity that buys Nvidia chips and servers and leases them to SpaceX (xAI) under the ~$40B GPU financing disclosed on 26 October 2026. The lease itself is spacex-apollo-2026-10-gpu-finance-lease.
summary_zh: 据彭博报道，PIMCO（品浩）认购了 40 亿美元的 A2（夹层）档 144A 票据，发行方是阿波罗管理的实体，该实体购买英伟达芯片和服务器并租给 SpaceX（xAI），对应 2026 年 10 月 26 日披露的约 400 亿美元 GPU 融资。租约本身另列为一条租赁边。

amount_text: $3.5B facility (amount drawn not disclosed); Term SOFR + 2.75%, stepping up to a maximum of 3.50%
title_en: Citi provides Nebius a $3.5B senior secured facility
title_zh: 花旗向 Nebius 提供 35 亿美元优先担保贷款
summary_en: Nebius entered a $3.5B, 364-day senior secured facility with Citi as lead arranger and agent, to fund data-centre development, GPU purchases and general purposes. Management said larger asset-backed loans against its contracts may follow.
summary_zh: Nebius 与花旗（牵头安排行及代理行）签订 35 亿美元、期限 364 天的优先担保贷款，用于数据中心建设、采购 GPU 及一般用途。管理层表示，未来可能以客户合同为抵押进行规模更大的资产支持融资。

amount_text: $850M 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2032-11-01, issued 2026-10-16 (initial purchasers hold a 13-day option for $150M more; exercise not yet reported)
title_en: Cipher Digital $850M convertible notes for Barber Lake
title_zh: Cipher Digital 发行 8.5 亿美元可转换票据，投向 Barber Lake
summary_en: Cipher Digital (formerly Cipher Mining) priced $850 million of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032; after capped calls, proceeds fund its additional equity in the Barber Lake AI campus (leased to Fluidstack and AWS) and HPC build-out.
summary_zh: Cipher Digital（原 Cipher Mining）定价发行 8.5 亿美元、2032 年到期的零息可转换优先票据；扣除上限看涨期权成本后，资金用于追加 Barber Lake AI 园区（租给 Fluidstack 和 AWS）的股权投入及高性能计算建设。

amount_text: ~$5.7B: $1.3B 2036 + $0.5B 2046 USD notes and CNY 26B (CNY 20B 10-yr, 6B 30-yr) dim sum notes; >$23B orders
title_en: Tencent ~$5.7B bond sale amid AI spending
title_zh: 腾讯约 57 亿美元发债应对 AI 支出
summary_en: Tencent raised about $5.7B in dollar and offshore yuan bonds, four months after its June deal, with orders above four times the size. Its first-half 2026 capex more than doubled to CNY 96.3B.
summary_zh: 腾讯在 6 月发债四个月后再发行约 57 亿美元的美元及离岸人民币债券，认购超过四倍。其 2026 年上半年资本开支翻倍至 963 亿元人民币。

subkind: senior secured fixed-rate delayed-draw GPU loan
amount_text: $1.008B senior secured delayed-draw term loan; 6.78% fixed; final maturity 2033-05-30; Baa1 (Moody's) / A (low) (Morningstar DBRS); JPMorgan sole coordinating lead arranger, structuring agent and bookrunner
term: matures 2033-05-30; delayed draw tied to cluster commissioning
title_en: Lambda $1.008B senior secured fixed-rate GPU loan
title_zh: Lambda 10.08 亿美元优先担保固定利率 GPU 贷款
summary_en: Lambda closed a $1.008 billion senior secured fixed-rate delayed-draw loan, secured by the GPU servers it funds and by contracted cash flows from two hyperscale customers, with JPMorgan as sole lead arranger; Lambda calls it its second institutional credit facility after the $926M syndicated term loan that closed on 27 August 2026. Bloomberg's 28 August report of a JPMorgan-arranged ~$1B private debt raise (separate edge) may describe the run-up to this financing.
summary_zh: Lambda 完成 10.08 亿美元优先担保固定利率延迟提款贷款，以所购 GPU 服务器及两家超大规模客户的合同现金流为抵押，摩根大通为独家牵头安排行；Lambda 称这是继 2026 年 8 月 27 日完成的 9.26 亿美元银团定期贷款之后的第二笔机构信贷。彭博 8 月 28 日关于摩根大通安排约 10 亿美元私募债务的报道（另见单独条目）可能指的是同一笔融资的筹备阶段。

amount_text: ~$1.1B five-year notes (reports range $1.1-1.15B), priced at 98.5 to yield 9.25%; S&P BB- on the notes; Goldman Sachs led
title_en: $1.1B junk bonds for Blue Owl-backed CoreWeave data centre
title_zh: Blue Owl 支持的 CoreWeave 数据中心发行 11 亿美元垃圾债
summary_en: A project company backed by Blue Owl affiliates and developed with PowerHouse Data Centers sold about $1.1B of five-year junk bonds to build the 76 MW Digital Drive campus near Richmond, Virginia, fully leased to CoreWeave; the 9.25% yield was about 2.7 points above similarly rated debt.
summary_zh: 由 Blue Owl 关联方支持、PowerHouse 数据中心参与开发的项目公司发行约 11 亿美元五年期垃圾债，用于建设弗吉尼亚州里士满附近、全部租给 CoreWeave 的 76 兆瓦 Digital Drive 园区；9.25% 的收益率比同评级债券高约 2.7 个百分点。

amount_text: ~$11.1B: $10B in three USD tranches (8.625%–9.75%) + €1B in two EUR tranches; reported as the largest high-yield corporate bond sale ever
title_en: SoftBank ~$11B junk bond sale to fund OpenAI payment
title_zh: 软银发行约 111 亿美元高收益债以支付 OpenAI 投资款
summary_en: SoftBank sold about $11.1B of dollar and euro high-yield bonds, rated BB+ by Fitch, to help fund its next $10B OpenAI payment, after an April 2026 $3.6B bond partly used to repay OpenAI-related bridge loans.
summary_zh: 软银发行约 111 亿美元美元及欧元高收益债（惠誉 BB+），用于支付下一笔 100 亿美元 OpenAI 投资款；此前其 2026 年 4 月发行的 36 亿美元债券部分用于偿还与 OpenAI 相关的过桥贷款。

amount_text: $25B after a $5B upsize in Sept 2026 (was $8.5B 2023, $13.5B 2024, $20B 2025); ~SOFR+225bp; matures Sept 2027; lenders not named
title_en: SoftBank $25B margin loan backed by Arm shares
title_zh: 软银以 Arm 股份质押的 250 亿美元保证金贷款
summary_en: SoftBank raised its Arm-share-backed margin loan for the third time, to $25B, to help fund its roughly $65B of OpenAI commitments; $20B had been drawn as of December 2025.
summary_zh: 软银第三次上调以 Arm 股份质押的保证金贷款至 250 亿美元，以支持其约 650 亿美元的 OpenAI 投资承诺；截至 2025 年 12 月已提取 200 亿美元。

amount_text: $4.2B 2.875% convertible senior notes due 2033 (upsized $3.7B plus the $500M option, exercised in full); ~$566M spent on capped calls
title_en: CoreWeave $4.2B convertible notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 42 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced an upsized $3.7B of 2.875% convertible notes due 2033, its third convertible offering in under a year; with the initial purchasers' $500M option exercised, $4.2B closed on 22 September 2026.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价扩容后的 37 亿美元、票息 2.875%、2033 年到期可转换票据，为其不到一年内第三只可转债；初始购买方全额行使 5 亿美元超额配售选择权后，于 2026 年 9 月 22 日完成 42 亿美元发行。

amount_text: ~$22B being lined up by 10 banks, Goldman Sachs lead (with SMBC, Barclays, BNP Paribas, Bank of Nova Scotia; Bloomberg); separate $1B revolver not counted; not confirmed closed
title_en: Goldman-led banks line up $22B chip loan for Blackstone-Google Crux AI
title_zh: 高盛牵头的银行为黑石与谷歌的 Crux AI 安排 220 亿美元芯片贷款
summary_en: A group of 10 banks led by Goldman Sachs is lining up about $22B of debt for Crux AI to buy Google TPUs, secured on the chips and customer contracts, Bloomberg reported; the banks are working to syndicate it and closing was not confirmed.
summary_zh: 据彭博报道，高盛牵头的 10 家银行正为 Crux AI 安排约 220 亿美元债务用于购买谷歌 TPU，以芯片和客户合同作抵押，并寻求银团分销；该融资是否已完成尚未得到确认。

amount_text: Up to $3.1B senior term loan; Citi, ING, Natixis CIB, QNB and UOB as lead arrangers and underwriters; launched to syndication in late October 2026
title_en: Zankore $3.1B senior term loan
title_zh: Zankore 31 亿美元优先定期贷款
summary_en: Zankore, the Indonesian AI cloud backed by Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison, Ooredoo, Nvidia and Nokia, signed a senior term loan of up to $3.1B underwritten by Citi, ING, Natixis CIB, QNB and UOB to buy and deploy Nvidia GPUs, starting with 100 MW toward a 1 GW AI factory. Reports say Nvidia supports the deal through a revenue-sharing and credit-support model; the banks launched it to syndication in late October.
summary_zh: 由 Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison、Ooredoo、英伟达和诺基亚支持的印尼 AI 云公司 Zankore 签署最高 31 亿美元优先定期贷款，由花旗、ING、法国外贸银行、卡塔尔国家银行和大华银行承销，用于采购和部署英伟达 GPU，首期 100 兆瓦，目标 1 吉瓦 AI 工厂。据报道英伟达以收入分成和信用支持方式为交易提供支撑；银行已于 10 月下旬启动银团分销。

title_en: Amazon's debut £4.25B sterling bond sale
title_zh: 亚马逊首次发行 42.5 亿英镑英镑债
summary_en: Amazon priced its first sterling bonds, £4.25B in four tranches due 2029-2045, after euro, Swiss franc and Canadian dollar deals earlier in 2026, to fund its AI build-out; settlement was about 14 September 2026.
summary_zh: 亚马逊首次发行英镑债券，分四档共 42.5 亿英镑（约 57.6 亿美元），2029 至 2045 年到期，此前 2026 年已发行欧元、瑞士法郎和加元债券，用于支持 AI 建设；约于 2026 年 9 月 14 日交割。

amount_text: $29.6B from 28 banks, Citigroup and JPMorgan as lead coordinators (edge points at Citi; JPMorgan named here); upsized from a $20B target; opening margin SOFR+68bp (vs ~85bp on the 2024 loan); 15 Chinese banks took $18.9B (64%); signed mid-September 2026
term: 3 years, with options to extend 2 more years
title_en: ByteDance $29.6B syndicated loan led by Citi and JPMorgan
title_zh: 花旗与摩根大通牵头为字节跳动安排 296 亿美元银团贷款
summary_en: ByteDance raised a $29.6B unsecured offshore loan coordinated by Citigroup and JPMorgan, up from a $20B target. Sources said the money would mainly fund AI plans and projects outside China; at the time of reporting it was set to be signed shortly. Bloomberg reported on 14 September 2026 that the loan had been signed with 28 banks: 15 Chinese lenders (ICBC $3B, Bank of China $2.5B, CCB $1.5B) provided $18.9B, HSBC and two other foreign banks $1.5B each.
summary_zh: 字节跳动获得由花旗和摩根大通统筹的 296 亿美元无抵押境外银团贷款，较 200 亿美元的目标上调。知情人士称资金主要用于 AI 相关计划及海外项目；报道时贷款即将签署。 彭博 2026 年 9 月 14 日报道，该贷款已与 28 家银行签署：15 家中资银行（工行 30 亿、中行 25 亿、建行 15 亿美元）合计出资 189 亿美元，汇丰等三家外资银行各出资 15 亿美元。

subkind: GPU-backed term loan and senior secured notes
amount_text: $2.4B: $1.2B senior secured term loan + $1.2B senior secured notes, led by Blue Owl-managed funds, drawn in tranches
title_en: Blue Owl leads $2.4B GPU financing for IREN
title_zh: Blue Owl 牵头为 IREN 提供 24 亿美元 GPU 融资
summary_en: Blue Owl-managed funds led a $2.4B compute-equipment financing for IREN, split between a term loan and secured notes, to buy Nvidia Blackwell Ultra GPUs for IREN's Mackenzie campus in British Columbia.
summary_zh: Blue Owl 管理的基金牵头为 IREN 提供 24 亿美元算力设备融资（定期贷款与优先担保票据各 12 亿美元），用于购买部署在不列颠哥伦比亚省 Mackenzie 园区的英伟达 Blackwell Ultra GPU。

amount_text: ~$1B reported by Bloomberg on 2026-08-28; not counted: this is the run-up report to the $1.008B JPMorgan loan that closed 2026-10-01 (jpmorgan-lambda-2026-10-fixed-rate-gpu-loan), which carries the amount
title_en: Lambda ~$1B private debt for GPUs leased to Microsoft
title_zh: Lambda 约 10 亿美元私募债务用于租给微软的 GPU
summary_en: Lambda raised about $1B of short-dated private debt, arranged by JPMorgan, to buy Nvidia GPUs that Microsoft will lease. Lambda's October 2026 release describes the $1.008B JPMorgan facility as its second institutional loan after the August term loan, so this report and that loan are treated as one deal and the amount is counted once, on the October edge.
summary_zh: Lambda 通过摩根大通安排约 10 亿美元短期私募债务，用于采购将租给微软的英伟达 GPU。 Lambda 在 2026 年 10 月的公告中称 10.08 亿美元的摩根大通贷款是继 8 月定期贷款之后的第二笔机构融资，因此本条报道与该贷款视为同一笔交易，金额仅计入 10 月的边。

subkind: senior secured revolving credit and letter-of-credit facilities
amount_text: $600M of committed senior secured facilities: $100M revolver (Adjusted Term SOFR + 1.75%, 3-year) + $500M letter-of-credit facility; JPMorgan administrative and collateral agent, Morgan Stanley lead-left arranger, commitments split equally among Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs and TD; undrawn at closing; credit agreement dated 2026-08-25, 8-K filed 2026-08-27
term: revolver matures 3 years from closing (extendable to 4 at the company's election)
title_en: Core Scientific $600M senior secured revolver and letter-of-credit facilities
title_zh: Core Scientific 6 亿美元优先担保循环信贷及信用证额度
summary_en: Core Scientific entered a senior secured credit agreement on 25 August 2026 with JPMorgan as agent: a $100 million revolver for working capital and a $500 million letter-of-credit facility to back utility and project obligations, secured by a first lien on substantially all assets; nothing was drawn at closing and the company expects it to free about $300 million of restricted cash. This is a new facility, distinct from the $1.0 billion March 2026 bridge that was repaid in May.
summary_zh: Core Scientific 于 2026 年 8 月 25 日与作为代理行的摩根大通签署优先担保信贷协议：1 亿美元循环信贷用于营运资金，5 亿美元信用证额度用于支持电力及项目义务，以几乎全部资产的第一顺位留置权作抵押；交割时未提款，公司预计可释放约 3 亿美元受限现金。这是一笔新额度，与 2026 年 3 月、已于 5 月偿还的 10 亿美元过桥贷款无关。

amount_text: A$5.5B in 4 tranches (3, 5, 10 and 20 years; 3-year priced +65bp, 20-year 6.9% coupon); ≈ US$3.9B at an approximate 0.71 USD/AUD rate; >A$18B of orders; priced 2026-08-19
title_en: Alphabet A$5.5B debut kangaroo bond (≈ US$3.9B), largest Australian corporate bond
title_zh: Alphabet 首次发行 55 亿澳元袋鼠债券（约 39 亿美元），澳大利亚最大公司债
summary_en: Alphabet raised A$5.5 billion in its first Australian-dollar bond on 19 August 2026, the largest corporate bond in the Australian market, in four tranches of 3 to 20 years with ANZ, Deutsche Bank, RBC and TD as joint lead managers; orders exceeded A$18 billion and the deal funds its AI build-out.
summary_zh: Alphabet 于 2026 年 8 月 19 日首次发行澳元债券，募集 55 亿澳元，为澳大利亚市场最大的公司债，共 4 档、期限 3 至 20 年，由澳新银行、德意志银行、加拿大皇家银行和道明证券联合牵头；认购超过 180 亿澳元，资金用于 AI 基础设施建设。

title_en: Nebius $5B convertible notes
title_zh: Nebius 发行 50 亿美元可转债
summary_en: Nebius priced an upsized $5.0B two-part convertible offering, its third in a year, taking its convertible issuance since Sept 2025 to $11.75B.
summary_zh: Nebius 定价扩容后的 50 亿美元两档可转换票据，为一年内第三次，使其自 2025 年 9 月以来可转债发行总额达 117.5 亿美元。

amount_text: ~$1.3B mezzanine loan led by Eagle Point Credit Management, part of a ~$16B project-finance package (≈$15B senior debt led by Morgan Stanley, reported to be guaranteed by Google); pricing undisclosed
title_en: Eagle Point $1.3B private-credit loan for Nexus Data Centers' Anthropic-anchored Texas campus
title_zh: Eagle Point 向 Nexus Data Centers 提供 13 亿美元私募信贷，用于以 Anthropic 为主租户的得州园区
summary_en: Eagle Point Credit Management led a roughly $1.3 billion mezzanine loan to Nexus Data Centers for its campus in Hubbard, Texas, where Anthropic is to be the primary tenant; the loan sits below about $15 billion of bank senior debt in a ~$16 billion project financing, according to Bloomberg.
summary_zh: 据彭博报道，Eagle Point Credit Management 牵头向 Nexus Data Centers 提供约 13 亿美元夹层贷款，用于其位于得州 Hubbard、以 Anthropic 为主租户的园区；该贷款在约 160 亿美元项目融资中位列约 150 亿美元银行优先债务之后。

title_en: AMD $4.75B senior notes
title_zh: AMD 发行 47.5 亿美元优先票据
summary_en: AMD sold $4.75B of senior unsecured notes in four tranches due 2029-2036 (priced 13 August, closed 17 August 2026), underwritten by Barclays, BofA, Citi, J.P. Morgan, Morgan Stanley and Wells Fargo, for general corporate purposes including repaying debt.
summary_zh: AMD 发行四档共 47.5 亿美元无担保优先票据，2029 至 2036 年到期（2026 年 8 月 13 日定价、8 月 17 日交割），由巴克莱、美国银行、花旗、摩根大通、摩根士丹利和富国银行承销，用于一般公司用途，包括偿还债务。

amount_text: $926M (marketed at $917M); SOFR+3%, issued at 99.5; matures 2030-12-31; Baa2
title_en: Lambda $926M GPU loan backed by Nvidia lease-back
title_zh: Lambda 获 9.26 亿美元 GPU 贷款（以英伟达回租合同支撑）
summary_en: Morgan Stanley led a $926M term loan, secured by GPU servers and their cash flows, to fund the hardware Nvidia rents back from Lambda under a ~$1.5B four-year lease, a widely noted circular arrangement.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利牵头 9.26 亿美元定期贷款，以 GPU 服务器及其现金流为抵押，为英伟达以约 15 亿美元、四年期从 Lambda 回租的硬件融资，被普遍视为循环交易。

amount_text: $2.6B, ~5-year maturity; JPMorgan and MUFG joint lead arrangers
title_en: CoreWeave $2.6B DDTL 5.5 loan
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 26 亿美元 DDTL 5.5 贷款
summary_en: CoreWeave closed another $2.6B delayed-draw loan whose ~5-year term outlasts the ~3-year customer contracts behind it, letting it finance shorter deals.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 再获 26 亿美元延迟提款贷款，约 5 年期限长于其背后约 3 年的客户合同，使其能为较短期合同融资。

amount_text: Up to $573.0M delayed-draw term loan to Riot DC Logistics; SOFR + 2.75%; matures 2026-12-31; non-recourse to Riot parent
title_en: Morgan Stanley $573M loan for Riot's 191 MW Rockdale AI build
title_zh: 摩根士丹利向 Riot 提供 5.73 亿美元贷款，建设 Rockdale 191 兆瓦 AI 数据中心
summary_en: Lenders led by Morgan Stanley Senior Funding gave Riot's subsidiary Riot DC Logistics a senior secured delayed-draw term loan of up to $573 million to buy long-lead equipment for the 191 MW data centre at Rockdale, Texas, leased to a frontier AI lab reported to be Anthropic. The loan is secured on the project companies only and matures at the end of 2026.
summary_zh: 以摩根士丹利为行政代理的银团向 Riot 子公司 Riot DC Logistics 提供最高 5.73 亿美元的优先担保延迟提款定期贷款，用于采购得州 Rockdale 191 兆瓦数据中心的长交期设备；该设施租给一家前沿 AI 实验室（据报为 Anthropic）。贷款仅以项目公司资产担保，2026 年底到期。

amount_text: $25B in 10 tranches (two floating, eight fixed at 4.500%-6.500%), due 2028-2066; ~$115B peak orders; settled ~10 Aug 2026
title_en: Alphabet $25B bond sale
title_zh: Alphabet 发行 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: After lifting 2026 capex to as much as $205B, Alphabet sold $25B of bonds in up to 10 tranches, drawing about $115B of peak orders.
summary_zh: Alphabet 将 2026 年资本开支上调至最高 2050 亿美元后，分至多 10 个期限发行 250 亿美元债券，峰值订单约 1150 亿美元。

amount_text: $10B two-year loan; lenders Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, Mizuho Securities, Apollo, SMBC; SoftBank guarantee
title_en: SoftBank $10B loan backed by its OpenAI stake
title_zh: 软银以 OpenAI 股份质押获 100 亿美元贷款
summary_en: SoftBank signed a two-year $10B margin loan secured by its OpenAI shares, disclosed in its quarterly report; Bloomberg reported on 2026-08-28 that it was seeking a second $10B loan against the same stake.
summary_zh: 软银签署以其 OpenAI 股份为抵押的两年期 100 亿美元保证金贷款，并在季报中披露；彭博 2026 年 8 月 28 日报道其正以同一股份寻求第二笔 100 亿美元贷款。

subkind: construction financing (bank bridge loan and related facilities)
amount_text: $15.6B construction financing per Evercore (adviser to Nexus); reported as ~$15B from a bank group led by Morgan Stanley (bridge to be refinanced) alongside a $1.3B Eagle Point mezzanine loan; split not disclosed
title_en: Morgan Stanley-led $15.6B financing for Nexus's Anthropic campus in Texas
title_zh: 摩根士丹利牵头为 Nexus 租给 Anthropic 的得州园区提供 156 亿美元融资
summary_en: Nexus Data Centers raised about $15.6 billion of construction financing, led by a Morgan Stanley bank group, for its inaugural data-centre and gas-power campus in Hubbard, Texas, which WSJ and CNBC reported is leased to Anthropic with Google guaranteeing lease and power payments. Evercore, Nexus's adviser, listed the financing among its Q3 2026 deals.
summary_zh: Nexus Data Centers 为其首个位于得州哈伯德、配套天然气电厂的数据中心园区筹得约 156 亿美元建设融资，由摩根士丹利牵头的银团提供；据《华尔街日报》和 CNBC 报道，该园区租给 Anthropic，谷歌为租金及电费提供担保。Nexus 的财务顾问 Evercore 在其 2026 年三季度业绩中列出了这笔融资。

amount_text: $3.507B 9.875% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at 99.5% by Galaxy Helios Data Centers II LLC
title_en: Galaxy $3.5B notes for CoreWeave's Helios Phase II
title_zh: Galaxy 为 CoreWeave 租用的 Helios 二期发行 35 亿美元票据
summary_en: Galaxy's subsidiary Galaxy Helios Data Centers II sold $3.507B of 9.875% senior secured notes due 2031 to build two buildings with 260 MW of critical IT capacity at Helios, leased to CoreWeave.
summary_zh: Galaxy 子公司 Galaxy Helios Data Centers II 发行 35.07 亿美元、票息 9.875%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于在 Helios 园区建设两栋共 260 兆瓦关键 IT 容量的楼宇，租户为 CoreWeave。

to_name: Sopaipilla Investor LLC (Meta El Paso JV)
amount_text: $12.3B single tranche due 2048, price talk ~T+287.5bp; one report puts the final size at ~$12.5B
title_en: $12.3B SPV bonds for Meta's El Paso campus
title_zh: 123 亿美元 SPV 债券支持 Meta 埃尔帕索园区
summary_en: Sopaipilla Investor, an 80% BlackRock (GIP and HPS) / 20% Meta vehicle, sold about $12.3B of notes due 2048 via JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley to fund Meta's ~1 GW El Paso, Texas campus off Meta's balance sheet, copying the Hyperion structure.
summary_zh: Sopaipilla Investor（贝莱德旗下 GIP 与 HPS 持股 80%、Meta 持股 20%）经摩根大通和摩根士丹利发行约 123 亿美元 2048 年到期票据，为 Meta 位于得州埃尔帕索、约 1 吉瓦的园区进行表外融资，结构复制 Hyperion 模式。

amount_text: $520M credit line; pricing, collateral and maturity not disclosed
title_en: Bank of America extends OpenAI a $520M credit line
title_zh: 美国银行向 OpenAI 提供 5.2 亿美元授信
summary_en: Bank of America gave OpenAI a $520M credit line, its first loan to the company and a reversal after it earlier declined a request, as OpenAI prepares for a possible IPO. Reported by Reuters and Bloomberg citing people familiar.
summary_zh: 美国银行向 OpenAI 提供 5.2 亿美元授信额度，这是其向该公司发放的首笔贷款，此前该行曾拒绝过相关请求；OpenAI 正为可能的上市做准备。路透社和彭博社援引知情人士报道。

title_en: Amazon $25B bond sale as demand cools
title_zh: 亚马逊在需求降温中发行 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: Amazon sold another $25B of bonds after a C$14B Canadian deal in June; peak orders (~$62B) were half those of its March sale. Amazon told underwriters it plans no more debt in 2026.
summary_zh: 继 6 月发行 140 亿加元债券后，亚马逊再发 250 亿美元债券；认购峰值约 620 亿美元，仅为 3 月的一半。亚马逊告知承销商 2026 年内不再发债。

amount_text: $25B in five tranches (2031–2056), coupons 5.35%–6.65%; ~$89B orders; Baa1/BBB+/BBB
title_en: SpaceX (xAI parent) $25B debut bond
title_zh: SpaceX（xAI 母公司）首发 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: Less than two weeks after its IPO, SpaceX, now xAI's parent, sold $25B of investment-grade bonds to repay the $20B bridge loan, paying about 40bp more than similarly rated issuers.
summary_zh: 上市不到两周，已成为 xAI 母公司的 SpaceX 发行 250 亿美元投资级债券以偿还 200 亿美元过桥贷款，利差比同评级发行人高约 40 个基点。

amount_text: $25B in 7 tranches: $3.5B 4.250% Notes due 2028; $3.5B 4.350% Notes due 2029; $4B 4.500% Notes due 2031; $3.5B 4.750% Notes due 2033; $4B 4.950% Notes due 2036; $3B 5.550% Notes due 2046; $3.5B 5.625% Notes due 2056
title_en: NVIDIA $25B notes offering
title_zh: 英伟达发行 250 亿美元票据
summary_en: NVIDIA sold $25B of notes in 7 tranches due 2028–2056, according to its 424B5 prospectus filed on 2026-06-17.
summary_zh: 根据 2026 年 6 月 17 日提交的 424B5 发行说明书，英伟达发行 250 亿美元票据，共 7 档，2028–2056 年到期。

amount_text: $1.25B 9.625% senior notes due 2032 + €2B 8.500% senior notes due 2032 (combined US-dollar total not disclosed by the company; launched as a ~$3.5B offering)
title_en: CoreWeave $1.25B + €2B senior notes due 2032
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 12.5 亿美元及 20 亿欧元 2032 年到期优先票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced $1.25B of 9.625% and €2B of 8.500% senior unsecured notes due 2032, closed on 18 June 2026, for general corporate purposes including repaying debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价 12.5 亿美元、票息 9.625% 及 20 亿欧元、票息 8.500%、2032 年到期的无担保优先票据，于 2026 年 6 月 18 日完成，用于一般企业用途（包括偿还债务）。

to_name: AI XPV (Broadcom chip-lease SPV for Anthropic)
amount_text: $35B initial capital solution led by Apollo funds with Blackstone and other banks; about half reportedly syndicated; multi-year draw schedule
title_en: Apollo and Blackstone lend $35B to Broadcom's chip SPV for Anthropic
title_zh: 阿波罗与黑石向博通为 Anthropic 设立的芯片 SPV 贷款 350 亿美元
summary_en: Apollo led, with Blackstone and other banks, a $35B initial financing for Broadcom's AI XPV platform, an SPV that buys Google-designed TPUs and leases them to Anthropic, with lease payments repaying the debt. Broadcom covers shortfalls to the senior A1/A2 notes if Anthropic stops paying and the chips cannot be sold for enough.
summary_zh: 阿波罗牵头、黑石及其他银行参与，为博通 AI XPV 平台提供 350 亿美元首期融资；该特殊目的实体购买谷歌设计的 TPU 并租给 Anthropic，以租金偿债。若 Anthropic 停付且出售芯片不足以偿还，博通负责补足优先级 A1/A2 票据的缺口。

amount_text: $1.59B 7.000% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at par by APLD ComputeCo 3 LLC; refinanced a Goldman Sachs bridge loan
title_en: Applied Digital $1.59B notes for the fourth CoreWeave building at Polaris Forge 1
title_zh: Applied Digital 为 Polaris Forge 1 第四栋楼发行 15.9 亿美元票据
summary_en: Applied Digital's subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 3 sold $1.59B of 7% senior secured notes due 2031 to build the 150 MW ELN-04 building at Polaris Forge 1 (the campus leased to CoreWeave) and repay a Goldman Sachs bridge loan; the offering closed on 16 June 2026.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 子公司 APLD ComputeCo 3 发行 15.9 亿美元、票息 7%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设 Polaris Forge 1 园区（租给 CoreWeave）150 兆瓦的 ELN-04 楼宇并偿还高盛过桥贷款，于 2026 年 6 月 16 日完成发行。

amount_text: $4.25B 6.129% senior secured notes due 2042, issued at par by Beacon Point DC LLC
title_en: Hut 8 $4.25B notes for its Beacon Point AI campus
title_zh: Hut 8 为 Beacon Point AI 园区发行 42.5 亿美元票据
summary_en: Hut 8's subsidiary Beacon Point DC sold $4.25B of 6.129% senior secured notes due 2042 to build a 352 MW AI data centre at Beacon Point in Nueces County, Texas, leased for 15 years (~$9.8B) to an unnamed AA-rated company.
summary_zh: Hut 8 子公司 Beacon Point DC 发行 42.5 亿美元、票息 6.129%、2042 年到期的优先担保票据，用于在得州纽埃塞斯县 Beacon Point 园区建设 352 兆瓦 AI 数据中心，该设施以 15 年、约 98 亿美元租给一家未具名的 AA 级公司。

amount_text: $4.66B: $1.75B 10-yr + $0.7B 20-yr USD notes and CNY 15B (~$2.21B) 10/30-yr notes; >$17B orders
title_en: Tencent $4.66B dual-currency bond sale
title_zh: 腾讯 46.6 亿美元双币种债券
summary_en: Tencent sold $2.45B of dollar notes and CNY 15B of offshore yuan notes, its first dollar bonds since 2021, for general corporate purposes including refinancing.
summary_zh: 腾讯发行 24.5 亿美元的美元票据和 150 亿元离岸人民币票据，为 2021 年以来首笔美元债，用于包括再融资在内的一般公司用途。

amount_text: C$14B maple bond in 5 tranches: C$1.25B 3.400% due 2029, C$2.5B 3.700% due 2031, C$2B 4.000% due 2033, C$3.5B 4.350% due 2036, C$4.75B 5.000% due 2056; ≈ US$10.2B at an approximate 0.73 USD/CAD rate; record Canadian-dollar corporate bond (~C$28B of orders); priced 2026-06-08/09, 424B5 filed 2026-06-10
title_en: Amazon C$14B maple bond (≈ US$10.2B), record Canadian corporate bond
title_zh: 亚马逊发行 140 亿加元枫叶债券（约 102 亿美元），创加拿大公司债纪录
summary_en: Amazon sold C$14 billion of Canadian-dollar senior notes in five tranches due 2029–2056, the largest corporate bond ever in Canada, beating Alphabet's C$8.5B maple bond of May; proceeds go to general corporate purposes including AI infrastructure. The 424B5 prospectus supplement was filed on 2026-06-10. Converted at roughly 0.73 USD per CAD (≈ US$10.2B).
summary_zh: 亚马逊发行 140 亿加元的加元计价优先票据，共 5 档，2029–2056 年到期，超过 Alphabet 5 月的 85 亿加元枫叶债券，成为加拿大史上最大的公司债；募集资金用于包括 AI 基础设施在内的一般公司用途。424B5 发行说明书补充文件于 2026 年 6 月 10 日提交。按约 0.73 美元/加元折算约 102 亿美元。

amount_text: $810.0M 6.000% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at 99.75% by Stingray Compute LLC; Morgan Stanley representative of initial purchasers; Cipher completion guarantee
title_en: Cipher Digital $810M notes for the AWS-leased Stingray data centre
title_zh: Cipher Digital 发行 8.1 亿美元票据，建设 AWS 租用的 Stingray 数据中心
summary_en: Cipher Digital's subsidiary Stingray Compute sold $810 million of 6% senior secured notes due 2031 to finance the remaining cost of the 70 MW Stingray data centre in Andrews, Texas, leased to AWS, reimburse Cipher's equity and fund debt reserves; the offering closed on 15 June 2026.
summary_zh: Cipher Digital 子公司 Stingray Compute 发行 8.1 亿美元、票息 6%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于支付租给 AWS 的得州安德鲁斯 70 兆瓦 Stingray 数据中心剩余建设成本、偿还 Cipher 前期股本投入并设立偿债准备金，于 2026 年 6 月 15 日完成发行。

subkind: senior unsecured delayed draw term loan
amount_text: $17.5B senior unsecured delayed-draw term loan (Citibank N.A. administrative agent); Term SOFR + 0.625–0.875%; commitments expire 30 Sep 2026 if not drawn; each loan matures 3 years after drawing
term: 3 years from each draw; draw period to 2026-09-30
title_en: Amazon $17.5B delayed-draw term loan led by Citibank
title_zh: 亚马逊获花旗牵头的 175 亿美元延迟提款定期贷款
summary_en: Amazon signed a $17.5B senior unsecured delayed-draw term loan with a bank group under Citibank as administrative agent, for general corporate purposes; undrawn commitments lapse on 30 September 2026.
summary_zh: 亚马逊与以花旗银行为行政代理行的银团签订 175 亿美元无担保延迟提款定期贷款，用于一般企业用途；未提取的额度于 2026 年 9 月 30 日失效。

subkind: contract-backed delayed draw term loan and senior secured notes
amount_text: ~$3.6B: ~$1.5B delayed-draw term loan (SOFR + 2.25%; Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan joint lead arrangers) + $2.1B 5.96% senior notes, both due 31 Dec 2031; drawn in tranches until 29 May 2027
title_en: Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan arrange $3.6B for IREN's Microsoft GPUs
title_zh: 高盛与摩根大通为 IREN 微软项目 GPU 安排 36 亿美元融资
summary_en: IREN subsidiary IE US Hardware 3 signed about $3.6B of financing, a $1.5B delayed-draw term loan arranged by Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan plus $2.1B of senior notes, to buy the GPUs for its $9.7B Microsoft contract at Childress, Texas; it is secured on the Microsoft contract and its cash flows.
summary_zh: IREN 子公司 IE US Hardware 3 签署约 36 亿美元融资，包括由高盛和摩根大通安排的 15 亿美元延迟提取定期贷款及 21 亿美元优先票据，用于为其得州 Childress 园区 97 亿美元微软合同采购 GPU，以微软合同及其现金流作抵押。

amount_text: ¥576.5B in 7 tranches (3- to 40-year, coupons 1.965%–4.599%); ≈ US$3.6B at an approximate 160 JPY/USD rate; largest yen bond by a foreign issuer; completed 2026-05-15
title_en: Alphabet ¥576.5B debut yen bond (≈ US$3.6B), record for a foreign issuer
title_zh: Alphabet 首次发行 5765 亿日元债券（约 36 亿美元），创外国发行人纪录
summary_en: Alphabet completed a 576.5 billion yen bond in Japan on 15 May 2026, its first in the currency and the largest yen bond ever by a foreign company (passing Berkshire Hathaway's 2019 record), in seven tranches of 3 to 40 years led by Mizuho Securities, Bank of America and Morgan Stanley.
summary_zh: Alphabet 于 2026 年 5 月 15 日在日本完成 5765 亿日元债券发行，为其首只日元债，也是外国公司有史以来最大的日元债（超过伯克希尔 2019 年纪录），共 7 档、期限 3 至 40 年，由瑞穗证券、美国银行和摩根士丹利牵头。

amount_text: $3.1B; Morgan Stanley Senior Funding administrative agent, co-led with MUFG; sold into the institutional leveraged-loan market
title_en: CoreWeave $3.1B GPU-backed term loan
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 31 亿美元 GPU 抵押定期贷款
summary_en: CoreWeave signed a $3.1B delayed-draw term loan to buy GPU servers for specific customer contracts, described as the first chip-backed loan placed in the institutional leveraged-loan market.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 签署 31 亿美元延迟提款定期贷款，用于为特定客户合同采购 GPU 服务器，被称为首笔在机构杠杆贷款市场配售的芯片抵押贷款。

amount_text: $5.0B five-year unsecured revolving credit facility (JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent)
title_en: JPMorgan-led $5B revolving credit facility for AMD
title_zh: 摩根大通牵头为 AMD 提供 50 亿美元循环信贷
summary_en: AMD entered a $5.0 billion five-year unsecured revolving credit facility with a bank group led by JPMorgan Chase Bank as administrative agent, replacing its earlier revolver (8-K filed 2026-05-15).
summary_zh: AMD 与以摩根大通银行为行政代理行的银团签订 50 亿美元、为期五年的无抵押循环信贷协议，取代此前的循环信贷（2026 年 5 月 15 日提交的 8-K）。

amount_text: CHF 2.82B in 6 tranches (3, 6, 9, 12, 18 and 25 years); ≈ US$3.6B at an approximate 1.28 USD/CHF rate; record six-part Swiss franc corporate bond; priced 2026-05-12
title_en: Amazon CHF 2.82B debut Swiss franc bond (≈ US$3.6B)
title_zh: 亚马逊首次发行 28.2 亿瑞士法郎债券（约 36 亿美元）
summary_en: Amazon sold its first Swiss franc bonds on 12 May 2026, raising CHF 2.82 billion across a record six tranches of 3 to 25 years arranged by BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank and JPMorgan; proceeds go to general corporate purposes including AI spending and debt repayment.
summary_zh: 亚马逊于 2026 年 5 月 12 日首次发行瑞士法郎债券，募集 28.2 亿瑞郎，创纪录地分为 6 档、期限 3 至 25 年，由法国巴黎银行、德意志银行和摩根大通安排；募集资金用于包括 AI 支出和偿债在内的一般公司用途。

amount_text: $2.6B 1.00% due 2033 priced (upsized from $2B) + $400M option exercised = $3.0B
title_en: IREN $3B convertible notes
title_zh: IREN 发行 30 亿美元可转债
summary_en: IREN priced $2.6B of 1% convertible notes due 2033 and the full $400M option was exercised, raising $3.0B for AI cloud expansion.
summary_zh: IREN 定价 26 亿美元、票息 1%、2033 年到期的可转换票据，4 亿美元超额配售全额行使，共募资 30 亿美元用于 AI 云扩张。

amount_text: $3.3B 7.750% Senior Secured Notes due 2031, issued at 99.250% by Core Scientific Finance I LLC (net proceeds ~$3.24B)
title_en: Core Scientific $3.3B senior secured notes due 2031
title_zh: Core Scientific 发行 33 亿美元优先担保票据（2031 年到期）
summary_en: A Core Scientific subsidiary completed a private offering of $3.3B of 7.750% senior secured notes due 2031 on 6 May 2026; proceeds fund a debt service reserve and repay the bridge loans.
summary_zh: Core Scientific 子公司于 2026 年 5 月 6 日完成 33 亿美元、利率 7.750%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据私募发行，所得用于偿债准备金并偿还过桥贷款。

amount_text: €9.0B in 6 tranches (coupons 3.200%–4.800%, maturities 2030–2063); ≈ US$10.5B at an approximate 1.17 USD/EUR rate; >€25B of orders (Bloomberg); priced 2026-05-05, closed 2026-05-11
title_en: Alphabet €9B euro bond (≈ US$10.5B), its largest in the currency
title_zh: Alphabet 发行 90 亿欧元债券（约 105 亿美元），其最大规模欧元债
summary_en: Alphabet priced €9 billion of SEC-registered euro senior notes in six tranches due 2030–2063 on 5 May 2026, its largest euro deal, in the same week as its C$8.5 billion maple bond; proceeds are for general corporate purposes amid capital spending of up to $190 billion in 2026.
summary_zh: Alphabet 于 2026 年 5 月 5 日定价发行 90 亿欧元、6 档、2030–2063 年到期的美国证监会注册欧元优先票据，为其最大规模欧元债，与 85 亿加元枫叶债券同周发行；募集资金用于一般公司用途，公司 2026 年资本开支最高达 1900 亿美元。

amount_text: C$8.5B maple bond in 4 tranches: C$1.5B 3.650% due 2031, C$2B 4.000% due 2033, C$2.25B 4.350% due 2036, C$2.75B 5.000% due 2056; ≈ US$6.2B at an approximate 0.73 USD/CAD rate; priced 2026-05-05, closed 2026-05-11
title_en: Alphabet C$8.5B maple bond (≈ US$6.2B), largest ever in Canada
title_zh: Alphabet 发行 85 亿加元枫叶债券（约 62 亿美元），加拿大史上最大
summary_en: Alphabet sold C$8.5 billion of Canadian-dollar senior notes in four tranches due 2031–2056, its first maple bond and the largest corporate bond in Canadian history, alongside a €9 billion euro deal the same week; the 424B2 pricing supplement was filed on 2026-05-07. Converted at roughly 0.73 USD per CAD (≈ US$6.2B).
summary_zh: Alphabet 发行 85 亿加元的加元计价优先票据，共 4 档，2031–2056 年到期，是其首只枫叶债券，也是加拿大历史上最大的公司债，同周还发行了 90 亿欧元债券；424B2 定价补充文件于 2026 年 5 月 7 日提交。按约 0.73 美元/加元折算约 62 亿美元。

amount_text: $3.25B 6.192% senior secured notes due 2042, issued at par by Hut 8 DC LLC
title_en: Hut 8 $3.25B notes for the River Bend (Fluidstack/Anthropic) campus
title_zh: Hut 8 为 River Bend 园区（Fluidstack/Anthropic）发行 32.5 亿美元票据
summary_en: Hut 8's subsidiary Hut 8 DC sold $3.25B of 6.192% senior secured notes due 2042 to build the 245 MW River Bend data centre leased to Fluidstack and its substation, and to reimburse Hut 8's equity; the notes amortise from 2028.
summary_zh: Hut 8 子公司 Hut 8 DC 发行 32.5 亿美元、票息 6.192%、2042 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设出租给 Fluidstack 的 245 兆瓦 River Bend 数据中心及变电站，并返还 Hut 8 已投入的股本；票据自 2028 年起分期摊还。

title_en: Meta $25B bond sale
title_zh: Meta 发行 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: A day after raising 2026 capex guidance to $125–145B, Meta sold $25B of bonds via Citi and Morgan Stanley. Orders (~$96B) were smaller than in Oct 2025 and most tranches priced at wider spreads, a sign of investor fatigue with AI debt.
summary_zh: Meta 将 2026 年资本开支指引上调至 1250–1450 亿美元的次日，经花旗和摩根士丹利发行 250 亿美元债券。认购（约 960 亿美元）低于 2025 年 10 月，且多数品种利差更宽，显示投资者对 AI 债务的疲劳。

amount_text: Debt size undisclosed; total campus cost ~$16B (Related Digital + Blackstone equity, PIMCO-anchored debt)
title_en: PIMCO-anchored debt for Oracle's $16B Michigan campus
title_zh: PIMCO 牵头认购甲骨文密歇根 160 亿美元园区的债务融资
summary_en: Related Digital and Blackstone funds financed the $16B 'The Barn' campus in Saline Township, Michigan, built for Oracle's OpenAI capacity, with fixed-rate long-term debt anchored by PIMCO and Bank of America as structuring agent. Blue Owl had walked away from the project in Dec 2025 after lenders reportedly pushed for tougher terms (Oracle disputed that account).
summary_zh: Related Digital 与黑石旗下基金为甲骨文服务 OpenAI 的密歇根 Saline 镇 160 亿美元“The Barn”园区完成融资，债务部分为 PIMCO（品浩）牵头认购的长期固定利率债务，美国银行担任结构安排行。此前 Blue Owl 因放贷方要求更严苛条款，于 2025 年 12 月退出该项目（甲骨文对此说法有异议）。

amount_text: ≈$3.6B: $1.5B 10-year USD notes at a record 8.5% coupon + €1.75B (≈$2.1B at an approximate 1.17 USD/EUR rate); priced 2026-04-15
title_en: SoftBank $3.6B high-yield bonds to repay OpenAI bridge loans
title_zh: 软银发行 36 亿美元高收益债券以偿还 OpenAI 相关过桥贷款
summary_en: SoftBank sold $1.5 billion and €1.75 billion of bonds on 15 April 2026, paying a record 8.5% on the 10-year dollar tranche, with part of the proceeds earmarked to repay bridge loans tied to its OpenAI investments.
summary_zh: 软银于 2026 年 4 月 15 日发行 15 亿美元及 17.5 亿欧元债券，10 年期美元债票息达创纪录的 8.5%，部分募集资金用于偿还与 OpenAI 投资相关的过桥贷款。

amount_text: $4.0B 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2032 (priced at an upsized $3.5B; initial purchasers' $500M option exercised, per the 10-Q)
title_en: CoreWeave $4B convertible notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 40 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced an upsized $3.5B of 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2032, a day after its 9.75% bond; with the $500M option exercised it issued $4.0B in April 2026.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 在发行 9.75% 债券次日，定价扩容后的 35 亿美元、票息 1.75%、2032 年到期可转换优先票据；加上行使的 5 亿美元超额配售，2026 年 4 月共发行 40 亿美元。

amount_text: $1.75B 9.750% senior notes due 2031 (Apr 9) + $1B tack-on at 102% (Apr 2026)
title_en: CoreWeave $2.75B 9.75% senior notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 27.5 亿美元 9.75% 优先票据
summary_en: CoreWeave sold $1.75B of 9.75% senior notes due 2031 and then a $1B add-on to the same notes, partly to repay debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 发行 17.5 亿美元、票息 9.75%、2031 年到期优先票据，随后同一品种增发 10 亿美元，部分用于偿债。

amount_text: $830M from seven banks (Bpifrance, BNP Paribas, Crédit Agricole CIB, HSBC, La Banque Postale, MUFG, Natixis CIB), per reports quoting the company
title_en: Mistral AI raises $830M of debt for Paris-area data centre
title_zh: Mistral AI 为巴黎附近数据中心举债 8.3 亿美元
summary_en: Mistral AI took its first big debt, an $830M loan from a seven-bank group, to fund Nvidia GB300 GPUs (about 13,800) and 44 MW at an Eclairion-run site in Bruyères-le-Châtel, south of Paris.
summary_zh: Mistral AI 首次大规模举债，从七家银行组成的银团获得 8.3 亿美元贷款，用于在巴黎南部 Bruyères-le-Châtel、由 Eclairion 运营的站点部署约 1.38 万颗英伟达 GB300 GPU 和 44 兆瓦容量。

subkind: investment-grade GPU-backed delayed draw term loan (DDTL 4.0)
amount_text: $8.5B (≈$7.5B initial, up to $8.5B on stabilisation); A3 (Moody's); floating SOFR+2.25% and ~5.9% fixed tranches; led by MUFG and Morgan Stanley
title_en: CoreWeave $8.5B investment-grade GPU loan
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 85 亿美元投资级 GPU 抵押贷款
summary_en: The first investment-grade rated GPU-backed financing: a non-recourse $8.5B loan secured by the chips and a customer contract that Bloomberg identified as CoreWeave's Meta deal. MUFG and Morgan Stanley led, with Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan and Blackstone participating.
summary_zh: 首笔获投资级评级的 GPU 抵押融资：85 亿美元无追索权贷款，以芯片及一份客户合同（彭博称为 CoreWeave 与 Meta 的合同）为抵押，由三菱日联与摩根士丹利牵头，高盛、摩根大通和黑石参与。

amount_text: $40B unsecured bridge; lenders JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Mizuho, SMBC, MUFG; matures 2027-03-25
title_en: SoftBank $40B bridge loan for its $30B OpenAI follow-on
title_zh: 软银 400 亿美元过桥贷款用于追加投资 OpenAI 300 亿美元
summary_en: SoftBank signed a $40B one-year bridge facility with five banks, mainly to fund its additional $30B investment in OpenAI's $110B+ round; it plans to repay in stages from asset sales and other financing. SoftBank drew $30B and prepaid the remaining $25.9B on 15 September 2026, retiring the facility; the undrawn $10B was cancelled on 30 September 2026.
summary_zh: 软银与五家银行签署 400 亿美元一年期过桥贷款，主要用于在 OpenAI 逾 1100 亿美元融资轮中追加投资 300 亿美元，计划通过出售资产及其他融资分阶段偿还。 软银共提取 300 亿美元，并于 2026 年 9 月 15 日提前偿还剩余 259 亿美元，该贷款已全部结清；未提取的 100 亿美元额度于 2026 年 9 月 30 日取消。

amount_text: $4.3375B at closing: $2.5875B 1.25% due 2031 (incl. $337.5M option exercised in full) + $1.75B 2.625% due 2033; a further option of up to $262.5M of 2033 notes was still open at closing (20 Mar 2026, 6-K)
title_en: Nebius $4.34B convertible notes
title_zh: Nebius 发行 43.4 亿美元可转债
summary_en: Nebius priced an upsized $4.0B two-part convertible note offering to keep funding AI capacity; with the option on the 2031 notes exercised, $4.34B closed on 20 March 2026.
summary_zh: Nebius 定价扩容后的 40 亿美元两档可转换票据，继续为 AI 算力建设融资；2031 年票据的超额认购权行使后，43.4 亿美元于 2026 年 3 月 20 日完成交割。

amount_text: $500M added on 18 March 2026, bringing the bridge facility to $1.0B; repaid 6 May 2026
title_en: JPMorgan $500M bridge loan to Core Scientific (repaid)
title_zh: 摩根大通向 Core Scientific 提供 5 亿美元过桥贷款（已偿还）
summary_en: An amendment of 18 March 2026 used the accordion in Core Scientific's bridge facility to add $500M of commitments from JPMorgan Chase Bank, taking it to $1.0B; repaid in full on 6 May 2026 from the $3.3B notes offering.
summary_zh: 2026 年 3 月 18 日的修订协议启用过桥信贷的增额条款，由摩根大通新增 5 亿美元承诺额，总额增至 10 亿美元；2026 年 5 月 6 日以 33 亿美元票据发行所得全部偿还。

amount_text: $500M 364-day delayed-draw senior secured bridge facility to Raylan Data LLC; SOFR + 2.75%
title_en: Morgan Stanley $500M bridge loan for TeraWulf's Hawesville campus
title_zh: 摩根士丹利为 TeraWulf Hawesville 园区提供 5 亿美元过桥贷款
summary_en: Lenders with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as agent provided TeraWulf's subsidiary Raylan Data a 364-day, $500 million delayed-draw secured bridge loan to build its data centre in Hawesville, Kentucky, the campus later leased to Anthropic (separate edge).
summary_zh: 以摩根士丹利为代理行的贷款方向 TeraWulf 子公司 Raylan Data 提供为期 364 天、5 亿美元的延迟提款有担保过桥贷款，用于建设肯塔基州 Hawesville 数据中心；该园区后来租给 Anthropic（另列）。

amount_text: $37B USD (11 tranches, 2–50 years) + €14.5B euro debut (~$16.8B at the March 2026 pricing-date rate, per Bloomberg's ~$54B total); Treasury & Risk's earlier headline said 'nearly $50B'
title_en: Amazon ~$54B dollar and euro bond sales
title_zh: 亚马逊发行约 540 亿美元美元及欧元债券
summary_en: Amazon raised $37B in dollars (about $126B of orders) plus a record €14.5B euro debut, one of the largest corporate bond sales ever not tied to an acquisition, to fund about $200B of 2026 capex.
summary_zh: 亚马逊发行 370 亿美元美元债（订单约 1260 亿美元），并首次发行创纪录的 145 亿欧元欧元债，成为史上最大的非并购类企业发债之一，用于 2026 年约 2000 亿美元资本开支。

amount_text: $10.0B five-year revolving credit agreement dated 6 Mar 2026, replacing a $6.0B revolver; undrawn at 31 May 2026
title_en: Oracle $10B revolving credit facility
title_zh: 甲骨文 100 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: Oracle replaced its $6B revolver with a new $10B five-year revolving credit agreement with a bank group in March 2026 and raised its commercial paper programme to $10B; nothing was drawn on the revolver at 31 May 2026.
summary_zh: 甲骨文于 2026 年 3 月以与银团签订的 100 亿美元五年期循环信贷协议取代原 60 亿美元额度，并将商业票据计划提高至 100 亿美元；截至 2026 年 5 月 31 日该循环额度未提款。

amount_text: $2.15B 6.750% senior secured notes due 2031, issued at 98% by APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC; priced 2026-03-04, closed ~2026-03-10 (proceeds held in escrow until the escrow condition was met)
title_en: Applied Digital $2.15B 6.75% secured notes for the Polaris Forge 2 campus
title_zh: Applied Digital 发行 21.5 亿美元 6.75% 担保票据，用于 Polaris Forge 2 园区
summary_en: Applied Digital's subsidiary APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC priced $2.15 billion of 6.75% senior secured notes due 2031 to fund 200 MW of critical IT load at the Polaris Forge 2 campus in Harwood, North Dakota, with Applied Digital giving a completion guarantee; the notes are secured by first-priority liens on the issuer's assets.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 子公司 APLD ComputeCo 2 LLC 定价发行 21.5 亿美元、票面利率 6.75%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设北达科他州 Harwood 的 Polaris Forge 2 园区 200 MW 关键 IT 负载，Applied Digital 提供完工担保；票据以发行人资产的第一顺位留置权作抵押。

amount_text: $500M of a $1.0B senior secured delayed-draw bridge facility (Term SOFR + 2.50%); repaid 6 May 2026
title_en: Morgan Stanley $500M bridge loan to Core Scientific (repaid)
title_zh: 摩根士丹利向 Core Scientific 提供 5 亿美元过桥贷款（已偿还）
summary_en: Core Scientific's 364-day Delayed-Draw Bridge Credit Agreement of 4 March 2026, with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding as administrative agent and initial $500M lender; it was repaid in full on 6 May 2026 from the $3.3B notes offering.
summary_zh: Core Scientific 于 2026 年 3 月 4 日签订 364 天延迟提款过桥信贷协议，摩根士丹利为行政代理行并提供首批 5 亿美元；2026 年 5 月 6 日以 33 亿美元票据发行所得全部偿还。

amount_text: $20B bridge (Goldman Sachs, BofA, Citi, JPMorgan, Morgan Stanley); retired ~$17.5–18.9B of X and xAI debt; repaid from June 2026 bonds
title_en: SpaceX $20B bridge loan to refinance xAI and X debt
title_zh: SpaceX 200 亿美元过桥贷款为 xAI 和 X 债务再融资
summary_en: After merging with xAI on 2026-02-02, SpaceX drew a Goldman-led $20B bridge loan to repay high-cost X and xAI debt (paying ~$1.16B of prepayment penalties), then refinanced the bridge with investment-grade bonds after its June IPO.
summary_zh: SpaceX 于 2026 年 2 月 2 日完成与 xAI 合并后，提取高盛牵头的 200 亿美元过桥贷款，偿还 X 和 xAI 的高成本债务（支付约 11.6 亿美元提前还款罚金），并在 6 月上市后以投资级债券置换该过桥贷款。

amount_text: US$10B facility led by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities and Blackstone Credit & Insurance, with Coatue
title_en: Blackstone leads $10B debt facility for Australia's Firmus
title_zh: 黑石牵头为澳大利亚 Firmus 提供 100 亿美元债务融资
summary_en: Blackstone funds led, with Coatue, a US$10B private debt facility for Nvidia-backed Firmus to fund the next stage of its Project Southgate AI factories.
summary_zh: 黑石基金牵头、Coatue 参与，为英伟达支持的 Firmus 提供 100 亿美元私募信贷额度，用于 Project Southgate AI 工厂下一阶段建设。

amount_text: Almost $32B: $20B USD (7 tranches) + £5.5B (~$7.5B, incl. £1B 100-year note) + CHF ~3.05B (~$3.95B)
title_en: Alphabet ~$32B multi-currency bonds incl. century bond
title_zh: Alphabet 发行近 320 亿美元多币种债券（含百年期债券）
summary_en: Alphabet borrowed almost $32B in under 24 hours across dollars, sterling and Swiss francs, including tech's first 100-year bond since 1997, after guiding 2026 capex to about $185B. The sterling and franc deals were each the largest corporate sales in those markets.
summary_zh: Alphabet 在将 2026 年资本开支指引定为约 1850 亿美元后，24 小时内以美元、英镑和瑞郎发债近 320 亿美元，其中包括自 1997 年以来科技公司首只百年期债券；英镑和瑞郎部分均创各自市场企业发债纪录。

amount_text: $2.0B 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031-02-15, issued at par by Black Pearl Compute LLC; ~$13B of orders (Bloomberg); priced 2026-02-04, closed 2026-02-11
title_en: Cipher Mining / Black Pearl Compute $2.0B secured notes for the AWS-leased Black Pearl site
title_zh: Cipher Mining / Black Pearl Compute 发行 20 亿美元担保票据，用于租给 AWS 的 Black Pearl 园区
summary_en: Cipher Mining's subsidiary Black Pearl Compute LLC sold $2.0 billion of 6.125% senior secured notes due 2031 to finish the Black Pearl data centre in Wink, Texas, which is leased to Amazon Web Services; the notes are guaranteed by the project subsidiaries and secured by first-priority liens on the project assets.
summary_zh: Cipher Mining 子公司 Black Pearl Compute LLC 发行 20 亿美元、票面利率 6.125%、2031 年到期的优先担保票据，用于完成位于得州 Wink、租给亚马逊云（AWS）的 Black Pearl 数据中心；票据由项目子公司担保，并以项目资产的第一顺位留置权作抵押。

amount_text: $25B in eight tranches (3–40 years); debt half of a $45–50B 2026 debt-and-equity plan; ~$129B peak orders reported
title_en: Oracle $25B bond sale in $45–50B 2026 funding plan
title_zh: 甲骨文发行 250 亿美元债券（2026 年 450–500 亿美元融资计划的一部分）
summary_en: Oracle sold $25B of bonds as the debt part of a plan to raise up to $50B in debt and equity in 2026; its Q3 release says $30B was raised within days through investment-grade bonds and mandatory convertible preferred stock, with no further bonds expected in calendar 2026. In July 2026 S&P cut Oracle to BBB-, one notch above junk, citing AI capex and reliance on OpenAI.
summary_zh: 甲骨文发行 250 亿美元债券，作为 2026 年最多 500 亿美元股债融资计划中的债务部分；其第三财季公告称，数日内通过投资级债券和强制可转换优先股募得 300 亿美元，并预计 2026 自然年内不再发债。2026 年 7 月，标普以 AI 资本开支和对 OpenAI 的依赖为由，将其评级下调至 BBB-（仅高于垃圾级一档）。

amount_text: $3.5B capital solution for a ~$5.4B GPU vehicle; part of xAI's Oct 2025 plan for ~$7.5B equity + up to $12.5B GPU-backed debt
title_en: Apollo $3.5B financing for xAI GPU vehicle
title_zh: 阿波罗为 xAI 的 GPU 特殊目的实体提供 35 亿美元融资
summary_en: Apollo funds led $3.5B of financing for Valor Compute Infrastructure, a Valor Equity Partners vehicle with Nvidia as anchor LP, that buys ~$5.4B of Nvidia GB200 systems and leases them to an xAI subsidiary. It is the realised part of the GPU SPV that Bloomberg reported in Oct 2025 (~$7.5B equity, up to $12.5B debt).
summary_zh: 阿波罗旗下基金牵头为 Valor Compute Infrastructure 提供 35 亿美元融资。该特殊目的实体由 Valor Equity Partners 管理、英伟达为基石有限合伙人，购买约 54 亿美元英伟达 GB200 系统并租给 xAI 子公司，是彭博 2025 年 10 月所报 GPU SPV（约 75 亿美元股权、最高 125 亿美元债务）的落地部分。

title_en: Broadcom $4.5B bond sale (January 2026)
title_zh: 博通发行 45 亿美元债券（2026 年 1 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold $4.5B of senior notes in four tranches due 2031 to 2056 for general corporate purposes, including redeeming earlier notes.
summary_zh: 博通发行四档共 45 亿美元优先票据（2031 至 2056 年到期），用于一般公司用途，包括赎回早期票据。

amount_text: $1,004,571,259 secured promissory note dated 2026-01-05 (Cerebras S-1): 6% interest, due 2032-12-31, repayable in cash or in compute/hardware (interest waived if repaid in services); carried as 'Loan from customer' of about $983M on Cerebras' balance sheet
title_en: OpenAI ~$1B working-capital loan to Cerebras, secured and paired with warrants
title_zh: OpenAI 向 Cerebras 提供约 10 亿美元营运资金贷款（有担保，附认股权证）
summary_en: Alongside its multi-gigawatt compute purchase, OpenAI advanced Cerebras about $1.0 billion under a secured promissory note (6%, due 31 December 2032) whose proceeds sit in a lockbox to build the contracted capacity; Cerebras may repay in cash or by delivering compute and hardware, and OpenAI separately holds warrants for up to 33.4 million Class N shares (see the investment edge).
summary_zh: 在数吉瓦算力采购协议之外，OpenAI 依据一份有担保本票（年息 6%，2032 年 12 月 31 日到期）向 Cerebras 预付约 10 亿美元，资金存入专户用于建设合同算力；Cerebras 可用现金或交付算力和硬件偿还，OpenAI 另持有最多 3344 万股 N 类普通股认股权证（见投资条目）。

amount_text: $1.3B 7.250% senior secured notes due 2030, issued at par by Flash Compute LLC (Abernathy JV subsidiary); Morgan Stanley representative of initial purchasers
title_en: TeraWulf–Fluidstack JV $1.3B notes for the Abernathy campus
title_zh: TeraWulf–Fluidstack 合资公司发行 13 亿美元票据建设 Abernathy 园区
summary_en: Flash Compute, a subsidiary of the TeraWulf (50.1%) and Fluidstack (49.9%) joint venture, sold $1.3 billion of 7.25% senior secured notes due 2030 to fund part of the 168 MW Abernathy, Texas campus leased to Fluidstack, with Google's lease backstop supporting the credit; the offering closed on 29 December 2025.
summary_zh: TeraWulf（持股 50.1%）与 Fluidstack（49.9%）合资公司旗下 Flash Compute 发行 13 亿美元、票息 7.25%、2030 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设租给 Fluidstack 的得州 Abernathy 168 兆瓦园区，谷歌的租金兜底为其增信，于 2025 年 12 月 29 日完成发行。

amount_text: $2.25B 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 (upsized from $2B; +$337.5M option)
title_en: CoreWeave $2.25B convertible notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 22.5 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced an upsized $2.25B of 1.75% convertible senior notes due 2031 for general corporate purposes and capped calls.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价扩容后的 22.5 亿美元、票息 1.75%、2031 年到期可转换优先票据，用于一般企业用途及上限看涨期权交易。

amount_text: $2B priced ($1B 0.25% due 2032 + $1B 1.00% due 2033); $2.3B incl. $300M option; ~$544M used to repurchase older converts
title_en: IREN $2.3B convertible notes for Microsoft build-out
title_zh: IREN 发行 23 亿美元可转债支持微软项目
summary_en: IREN sold $2B (+$300M option) of convertible notes to fund data centres and GPUs for its ~$9.7B five-year Microsoft AI cloud contract and to buy back older notes.
summary_zh: IREN 发行 20 亿美元（另含 3 亿美元超额配售）可转换票据，用于其与微软约 97 亿美元五年期 AI 云合同所需的数据中心和 GPU，并回购旧可转债。

amount_text: $15B in six tranches (longest 2065); ~$80B peak orders
title_en: Amazon $15B bond sale, first US deal in three years
title_zh: 亚马逊发行 150 亿美元债券（三年来首次美元发债）
summary_en: Amazon returned to the US bond market for the first time in about three years with a $15B six-part sale to help fund ~$125B of 2025 capex driven by AI.
summary_zh: 亚马逊约三年来首次重返美元债市场，分六档发行 150 亿美元债券，支持 2025 年约 1250 亿美元、以 AI 为主的资本开支。

amount_text: $2.35B 9.250% senior secured notes due 2030-12-15, issued at 97% by APLD ComputeCo LLC; priced 2025-11-13, closed 2025-11-20; amortisation from 2027-12-15
title_en: Applied Digital $2.35B 9.25% secured notes for CoreWeave-leased Polaris Forge 1 buildings
title_zh: Applied Digital 发行 23.5 亿美元 9.25% 担保票据，用于租给 CoreWeave 的 Polaris Forge 1 数据中心
summary_en: Applied Digital's subsidiary APLD ComputeCo LLC sold $2.35 billion of 9.25% senior secured notes due 2030 to build the 100 MW ELN-02 and 150 MW ELN-03 buildings at the Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota, leased to CoreWeave, and to repay an SMBC loan and fund debt-service reserves.
summary_zh: Applied Digital 子公司 APLD ComputeCo LLC 发行 23.5 亿美元、票面利率 9.25%、2030 年到期的优先担保票据，用于建设北达科他州 Ellendale 的 Polaris Forge 1 园区中租给 CoreWeave 的 100 MW ELN-02 和 150 MW ELN-03 数据中心，并偿还三井住友贷款及设立偿债准备金。

amount_text: $2.5B revolving credit facility (upsized from $1.5B; originally $650M in Oct 2024), maturity extended from May 2028 to November 2029; lead banks JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and MUFG, with Citi, Crédit Agricole, Deutsche Bank, SMBC and Wells Fargo
title_en: CoreWeave $2.5B revolving credit facility
title_zh: CoreWeave 25 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: CoreWeave amended its revolving credit facility on 12 November 2025, raising it from $1.5 billion to $2.5 billion and extending maturity to November 2029; JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley and MUFG led the nine-bank group. The facility backs general corporate liquidity rather than a specific GPU purchase.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 于 2025 年 11 月 12 日修订其循环信贷额度，由 15 亿美元上调至 25 亿美元，到期日延长至 2029 年 11 月；由摩根大通、高盛、摩根士丹利和三菱日联牵头的九家银行参与。该额度用于一般公司流动性，而非特定的 GPU 采购。

amount_text: ~$18B from ~20 banks; agents SMBC, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, MUFG; ~SOFR+250bp, 4 years + two 1-year extensions; quoted at 89–91 cents in Sept 2026
title_en: $18B bank loan for Oracle-linked Project Jupiter, New Mexico
title_zh: 180 亿美元银团贷款支持甲骨文相关的新墨西哥州 Jupiter 项目
summary_en: About 20 banks led by SMBC, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs and MUFG lent ~$18B to build the Stargate-linked Project Jupiter campus in Doña Ana County that Oracle will lease, developed by Blue Owl's Stack Infrastructure. By Sept 2026 the loans traded at 89–91 cents after gas-pipeline delays, and Oracle sent a force-majeure notice to defer payments if the 2028 opening slips, while saying the project is on schedule.
summary_zh: 约 20 家银行（三井住友、法国巴黎银行、高盛、三菱日联为代理行）提供约 180 亿美元贷款，建设由 Blue Owl 旗下 STACK Infrastructure 开发、甲骨文承租的星际之门相关新墨西哥 Jupiter 园区。因天然气管道延误，2026 年 9 月贷款报价跌至 89–91 美分；甲骨文发出不可抗力通知，若 2028 年无法投运可推迟付款，但称项目仍按计划推进。

amount_text: $1.4B 7.125% senior secured notes due 2030 (Cipher Compute LLC); a further $333M add-on was planned in Nov 2025
title_en: Cipher $1.4B secured notes for Barber Lake AI campus
title_zh: Cipher 发行 14 亿美元优先担保票据建设 Barber Lake AI 园区
summary_en: Cipher Mining's subsidiary sold $1.4B of 7.125% secured notes to fund the Barber Lake data centre leased to Fluidstack and backstopped by Google.
summary_zh: Cipher Mining 子公司发行 14 亿美元、票息 7.125% 的优先担保票据，为租给 Fluidstack、由谷歌兜底的 Barber Lake 数据中心融资。

title_en: Alphabet ~$25B US and euro bond sales
title_zh: 谷歌母公司 Alphabet 在美欧发行约 250 亿美元债券
summary_en: Alphabet raised about $25B in a week: $17.5B of US bonds after €6.5B in Europe, to fund AI data-centre capex.
summary_zh: Alphabet 一周内筹资约 250 亿美元：继在欧洲发行 65 亿欧元债券后，又在美国发行 175 亿美元债券，用于 AI 数据中心资本开支。

amount_text: $30B in six tranches; record ~$125B order book
title_en: Meta $30B bond sale
title_zh: Meta 发行 300 亿美元债券
summary_en: Meta sold $30B of bonds, the biggest US high-grade deal of 2025, drawing a record ~$125B of orders on the day its shares fell after it signalled much higher AI capex.
summary_zh: Meta 发行 300 亿美元债券，为 2025 年美国最大的投资级发债，认购订单创纪录达约 1250 亿美元；当天其股价因释放更高 AI 资本开支信号而下跌。

amount_text: $1.025B 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2032-05-01 ($900M priced 2025-10-29 plus $125M option exercised in full); 37.5% conversion premium; net proceeds ~$999.7M; closed 2025-10-31
title_en: TeraWulf $1.025B zero-coupon convertible notes for the Abernathy, Texas campus
title_zh: TeraWulf 发行 10.25 亿美元零息可转换票据，用于得州 Abernathy 园区
summary_en: TeraWulf sold $1.025 billion of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032 in a private 144A offering led by Morgan Stanley and Cantor Fitzgerald, upsized from $900 million, to fund part of the construction of its Abernathy, Texas data-centre campus and for general corporate purposes.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 通过由摩根士丹利和 Cantor Fitzgerald 牵头的 144A 私募发行 10.25 亿美元、2032 年到期的零息可转换优先票据（由 9 亿美元上调），用于其得州 Abernathy 数据中心园区的部分建设及一般公司用途。

amount_text: $38B: $23.25B (Shackelford County, Texas) + $14.75B (Port Washington, Wisconsin); ~SOFR+250bp, 4 years + two 1-year extensions
title_en: $38B bank loans for Oracle-leased Vantage data centres
title_zh: 380 亿美元银行贷款支持甲骨文租用的 Vantage 数据中心
summary_en: JPMorgan and MUFG led a record $38B pair of construction loans for two Vantage Data Centers campuses in Texas and Wisconsin that Oracle leases to serve OpenAI under Stargate. More than six months later banks were still selling down the last <$1B, some at a discount to non-bank buyers.
summary_zh: 摩根大通与三菱日联牵头，为 Vantage 在得州和威斯康星州的两个数据中心园区提供创纪录的 380 亿美元建设贷款，园区由甲骨文承租、用于星际之门项目下的 OpenAI 算力。半年多后银行仍在分销最后不足 10 亿美元的份额，部分以折价卖给非银行买家。

amount_text: $27.3B 6.58% senior secured notes due 2049 (A+ by S&P), one tranche, sole lead Morgan Stanley; PIMCO ~$18B anchor (reported) and BlackRock funds >$3B; the PIMCO allocation (pimco-beignet-2025-10-hyperion-notes) carries no amount of its own
title_en: Meta Hyperion SPV (Beignet Investor) $27.3B senior secured notes
title_zh: Meta Hyperion 特殊目的实体（Beignet Investor）发行 273 亿美元优先担保票据
summary_en: Beignet Investor, the Blue Owl (80%) / Meta (20%) joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana, sold $27.3B of 6.58% senior secured notes due 2049, the largest single-tranche bond on record (sole lead Morgan Stanley). PIMCO was the anchor buyer with about $18B and BlackRock funds took more than $3B; the debt sits off Meta's balance sheet and the notes traded around 91 cents on the dollar in early October 2026.
summary_zh: Beignet Investor 是 Blue Owl（80%）与 Meta（20%）的合资公司，持有 Meta 位于路易斯安那州的 Hyperion 园区，发行 273 亿美元、票息 6.58%、2049 年到期的优先担保票据，为史上最大单一档债券（摩根士丹利独家牵头）。PIMCO（品浩）为主力认购方，买入约 180 亿美元，贝莱德旗下基金认购逾 30 亿美元；债务不计入 Meta 资产负债表，2026 年 10 月初该债券跌至约 91 美分。

amount_text: $3.2B 7.750% senior secured notes due 2030, issued by WULF Compute LLC; Morgan Stanley initial purchaser
title_en: TeraWulf $3.2B secured notes for Lake Mariner AI campus
title_zh: TeraWulf 发行 32 亿美元优先担保票据建设 Lake Mariner AI 园区
summary_en: TeraWulf's subsidiary sold $3.2B of 7.75% secured notes to build Fluidstack's data halls at Lake Mariner, New York; Google's pledged warrants form part of the collateral until completion.
summary_zh: TeraWulf 子公司发行 32 亿美元、票息 7.75% 的优先担保票据，为 Fluidstack 建设纽约 Lake Mariner 数据机房；完工前谷歌质押的认股权证构成部分抵押品。

amount_text: ~$18B anchor allocation (reported) of the $27.3B 6.58% senior secured notes due 2049; part of bond-investors-beignet-2025-10-hyperion-notes, where the whole bond is counted, so no amount is counted here
title_en: PIMCO buys ~$18B of Meta Hyperion SPV bonds
title_zh: PIMCO 认购约 180 亿美元 Meta Hyperion SPV 债券
summary_en: PIMCO was the anchor buyer, taking about $18B of the $27.3B single-tranche bond issued by Beignet Investor, the Blue Owl (80%) / Meta (20%) joint venture that owns Meta's Hyperion campus in Louisiana. This is a holder allocation within one bond, counted on bond-investors-beignet-2025-10-hyperion-notes, not a separate instrument.
summary_zh: PIMCO（品浩）为主力认购方，买入 Beignet Investor 发行的 273 亿美元单一档债券中约 180 亿美元。Beignet 是 Blue Owl（80%）与 Meta（20%）的合资公司，持有 Meta 位于路易斯安那州的 Hyperion 园区。这是同一只债券中的持有人份额，金额已计入 Beignet Investor 273 亿美元票据这条边，并非单独的融资工具。

amount_text: $18B in six tranches incl. a 40-year note; ~$88B peak orders
title_en: Oracle $18B bond sale for AI infrastructure
title_zh: 甲骨文发行 180 亿美元债券为 AI 基础设施融资
summary_en: Oracle sold $18B of investment-grade bonds in six parts, including a rare 40-year note, to fund AI data-centre spending tied largely to its OpenAI contracts. It was the second-largest US high-grade bond sale of 2025 at the time.
summary_zh: 甲骨文分六档发行 180 亿美元投资级债券（含罕见的 40 年期品种），资金用于主要与 OpenAI 合同相关的 AI 数据中心资本开支，规模一度为 2025 年美国第二大投资级发债。

amount_text: CNY 9B (~$1.27B): CNY 2B 2.1% 5-year, CNY 6B 2.5% 10-year, CNY 1B 3.1% 30-year (tenors per Reuters)
title_en: Tencent CNY 9B debut dim sum bonds
title_zh: 腾讯首发 90 亿元离岸人民币债券
summary_en: Tencent raised CNY 9B (about $1.27B) in its first offshore yuan bond and first bond sale in four years, for general corporate needs.
summary_zh: 腾讯发行 90 亿元人民币（约 12.7 亿美元）离岸人民币债券，为其首笔点心债，也是四年来首次发债，用于一般公司用途。

amount_text: ~$3.2B zero-coupon convertible notes due 2032
title_en: Alibaba $3.2B convertible to fund cloud and AI
title_zh: 阿里巴巴 32 亿美元可转债投向云与 AI
summary_en: Alibaba issued about $3.2B of zero-coupon convertible notes due 2032, with proceeds for general corporate purposes with a focus on strengthening cloud infrastructure and its international commerce business.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发行约 32 亿美元、2032 年到期的零息可转换票据，所得款项用于一般公司用途，重点加强云基础设施和国际电商业务。

amount_text: ~$3.16B: ~$1.58B 1.00% due 2030 + ~$1.58B 2.75% due 2032, incl. the initial purchasers' option exercised at closing (priced at $2.75B, upsized from $2B); closed 15 Sept 2025 with a concurrent ~$1B share sale
title_en: Nebius $3.16B convertible notes after Microsoft deal
title_zh: Nebius 在微软合同后发行 31.6 亿美元可转债
summary_en: Shortly after announcing a multi-billion-dollar capacity contract with Microsoft, Nebius sold convertible notes plus about $1B of stock to fund data-centre build-out; with the buyers' option exercised, the notes came to about $3.16B at closing on 15 September 2025.
summary_zh: 在宣布与微软签署数十亿美元算力合同后不久，Nebius 发行可转换票据并增发约 10 亿美元股票，用于数据中心建设；初始购买方行使超额认购权后，票据于 2025 年 9 月 15 日交割时合计约 31.6 亿美元。

amount_text: €600M (~$703M as reported)
title_en: Deutsche Bank lends EcoDataCenter €600M
title_zh: 德意志银行向 EcoDataCenter 提供 6 亿欧元贷款
summary_en: Swedish data-centre operator EcoDataCenter, owned by Areim, raised €600M of debt from Deutsche Bank Private Credit and Infrastructure, mainly to expand its Falun and Borlänge campuses (Borlänge later hosts Mistral AI's Swedish site).
summary_zh: Areim 旗下瑞典数据中心运营商 EcoDataCenter 从德意志银行私募信贷与基础设施部门获得 6 亿欧元债务融资，主要用于扩建法伦和博伦厄园区（博伦厄后来成为 Mistral AI 瑞典站点所在地）。

amount_text: CNY 4.4B (~$618M at ~7.12 CNY/USD), 1.90% coupon, due 2029
title_en: Baidu CNY 4.4B dim sum bonds for AI
title_zh: 百度 44 亿元离岸人民币债券支持 AI
summary_en: Baidu sold CNY 4.4B of 1.90% senior unsecured notes due 2029 for general corporate purposes including repaying debt, as it funds AI; completed on 15 September 2025. With the March deal it raised CNY 14.4B in dim sum bonds in 2025.
summary_zh: 百度发行 44 亿元人民币、票息 1.90%、2029 年到期的优先无担保票据，用于偿债等一般公司用途，支持其 AI 投入，于 2025 年 9 月 15 日完成；连同 3 月发行，2025 年点心债共募资 144 亿元人民币。

amount_text: $1.4B senior secured term loan; SOFR (2.5% floor) + 4.75%; 80% loan-to-cost
title_en: Deutsche Bank $1.4B project loan for Galaxy's Helios (CoreWeave) campus
title_zh: 德意志银行为 Galaxy Helios 园区（CoreWeave 租用）提供 14 亿美元项目贷款
summary_en: Deutsche Bank is the initial lender on a $1.4B senior secured term loan to Galaxy Helios I LLC to build Phase I of the Helios campus leased to CoreWeave, secured by the project's assets; Galaxy put in about $350M of equity.
summary_zh: 德意志银行作为初始贷款方，向 Galaxy Helios I LLC 提供 14 亿美元优先担保定期贷款，用于建设租给 CoreWeave 的 Helios 园区一期，以项目资产作抵押；Galaxy 投入约 3.5 亿美元股本。

amount_text: $2.6B; led by Morgan Stanley and MUFG (Goldman Sachs joint lead arranger); reported SOFR+4%
title_en: CoreWeave $2.6B loan to serve OpenAI contract
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 26 亿美元贷款以履行 OpenAI 合同
summary_en: Morgan Stanley and MUFG led a $2.6B delayed-draw loan, with JPMorgan, Wells Fargo, SMBC and others, to fund GPUs and infrastructure for CoreWeave's long-term OpenAI contract.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利与三菱日联牵头（摩根大通、富国、三井住友等参与）提供 26 亿美元延迟提款定期贷款，为 CoreWeave 与 OpenAI 的长期合同采购 GPU 和基础设施。

amount_text: $1.75B 9.000% senior notes due 2031 (upsized by $250M)
title_en: CoreWeave $1.75B senior notes
title_zh: CoreWeave 发行 17.5 亿美元优先票据
summary_en: CoreWeave priced $1.75B of 9% senior notes due 2031 for general corporate purposes including refinancing.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 定价 17.5 亿美元、票息 9%、2031 年到期的优先票据，用于一般企业用途及再融资。

amount_text: HK$12.023B (~$1.53B) zero-coupon bonds due July 2032, exchangeable into Alibaba Health shares
title_en: Alibaba HK$12B exchangeable bonds for cloud and commerce
title_zh: 阿里巴巴 120 亿港元可交换债券用于云与国际电商
summary_en: Alibaba sold HK$12.023B of zero-coupon bonds exchangeable into shares of Alibaba Health, with proceeds for general corporate purposes including investment in its cloud infrastructure and international commerce businesses.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发行 120.23 亿港元零息可交换债券（可换股为阿里健康股份），所得款项用于一般公司用途，包括投资云基础设施和国际电商业务。

amount_text: $5B secured notes + term loans (fixed ~12%, floating SOFR+700bp reported); repaid in March 2026
title_en: xAI $5B bonds and loans via Morgan Stanley (repaid)
title_zh: xAI 经摩根士丹利发行 50 亿美元债券及贷款（已偿还）
summary_en: Morgan Stanley placed $5B of xAI secured notes and term loans at junk-level yields alongside $5B of equity. After SpaceX acquired xAI in Feb 2026, the debt was retired in March 2026 with SpaceX's $20B bridge loan.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利为 xAI 配售 50 亿美元优先担保票据和定期贷款（垃圾级收益率），同时 xAI 获 50 亿美元股权融资。SpaceX 于 2026 年 2 月收购 xAI 后，这笔债务于 2026 年 3 月由 SpaceX 的 200 亿美元过桥贷款偿清。

amount_text: $750M credit facility from Brookfield's infrastructure debt platform
title_en: Brookfield provides Crusoe a $750M credit facility
title_zh: 布鲁克菲尔德向 Crusoe 提供 7.5 亿美元信贷额度
summary_en: Crusoe secured a $750M credit facility from Brookfield Asset Management's infrastructure debt business, mainly to expand its AI factories (purpose-built AI data centres) and AI cloud platform.
summary_zh: Crusoe 从布鲁克菲尔德资产管理的基础设施债务业务获得 7.5 亿美元信贷额度，主要用于扩建其 AI 工厂（专用 AI 数据中心）和 AI 云平台。

amount_text: $7.1B construction loan for phase 2 of a $15B, 1.2 GW JV (JPMorgan total across both loans ~$9.6B)
title_en: JPMorgan-led $7.1B loan for Abilene Stargate phase 2
title_zh: 摩根大通牵头 71 亿美元贷款支持阿比林星际之门二期
summary_en: A JPMorgan-led consortium lent $7.1B for phase 2 of the 1.2 GW Abilene campus, owned by a $15B Crusoe / Blue Owl / Primary Digital joint venture and leased to Oracle for OpenAI.
summary_zh: 摩根大通牵头的银团提供 71 亿美元贷款，建设 1.2 吉瓦阿比林园区二期；园区由 Crusoe、Blue Owl 与 Primary Digital 组成的 150 亿美元合资公司持有，租给甲骨文供 OpenAI 使用。

amount_text: $2B 9.250% senior notes due 2030 (upsized)
title_en: CoreWeave $2B high-yield bond debut
title_zh: CoreWeave 首发 20 亿美元高收益债
summary_en: CoreWeave's first bond after its IPO: $2B of 9.25% unsecured senior notes due 2030, used partly to repay existing debt.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 上市后首只债券：20 亿美元、票息 9.25%、2030 年到期的无担保优先票据，部分用于偿还现有债务。

amount_text: $15B senior secured revolver under the amended and restated credit agreement of 4 Sept 2026 (Morgan Stanley Senior Funding agent), maturing 4 Sept 2031; grown from $2.5B (May 2025) to $2.75B (Sept 2025) and $3.25B (Nov 2025); undrawn at 30 June 2026 apart from $78M of letters of credit (Anthropic S-1)
title_en: Anthropic $15B revolving credit facility
title_zh: Anthropic 150 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: Anthropic's revolver from banks led by Morgan Stanley, opened at $2.5B in May 2025 with Barclays, Citi, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan, RBC and MUFG, was enlarged to $15B in September 2026 and now runs to 2031. The S-1 says it is secured on substantially all assets until Anthropic wins investment-grade ratings and requires at least $5B of liquidity.
summary_zh: Anthropic 由摩根士丹利牵头的循环信贷额度于 2025 年 5 月以 25 亿美元设立（参与银行包括巴克莱、花旗、高盛、摩根大通、加拿大皇家银行和三菱日联），2026 年 9 月扩大至 150 亿美元，期限延至 2031 年。S-1 显示，在获得投资级评级前该额度以几乎全部资产担保，并要求公司保持至少 50 亿美元流动性。

amount_text: $4.5B in four tranches: $1.5B 3-year, $1B 5-year, $1B 7-year, $1B 10-year notes (maturities 2028-2035)
title_en: Apple $4.5B bond sale, its first in two years
title_zh: 苹果发行 45 亿美元债券，两年来首次
summary_en: Apple sold $4.5B of bonds in four tranches, its first offering in two years, to fund buybacks and repay debt; orders reached about $10B.
summary_zh: 苹果发行四档共 45 亿美元债券，为两年来首次发债，用于回购股票和偿还债务，认购约 100 亿美元。

amount_text: $15B one-year bridge ($8.5B drawn for OpenAI, $6.5B for Ampere per SoftBank's FY2025 report); lead underwriters Mizuho, SMBC, JPMorgan, 21 banks; reported May 2025 (day not given); repaid by maturity in April 2026
term: 1 year; fully repaid by maturity in April 2026
title_en: SoftBank $15B bridge loan for OpenAI and Ampere
title_zh: 软银 150 亿美元过桥贷款用于 OpenAI 与 Ampere 投资
summary_en: SoftBank took a one-year $15B bridge loan, underwritten by Mizuho, SMBC and JPMorgan, to fund its first OpenAI investments and the $6.5B Ampere acquisition. SoftBank's FY2025 consolidated financial report (year to 31 March 2026) says the borrowings were fully repaid by their maturity in April 2026.
summary_zh: 软银获得由瑞穗、三井住友和摩根大通包销的一年期 150 亿美元过桥贷款，用于首批 OpenAI 投资及 65 亿美元收购 Ampere。据软银 2025 财年（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）合并财务报告，该贷款已于 2026 年 4 月到期前全部偿还。

amount_text: $1.75B: $500M 5.65% notes due Nov 2032 + $1.25B 6.05% notes due 2035. Micron prepaid $429M of the 2032 notes and $1,030M of the 2035 notes on 3 April 2026, leaving $71M and $220M (10-K for fiscal 2026)
title_en: Micron $1.75B senior notes
title_zh: 美光发行 17.5 亿美元优先票据
summary_en: Micron sold $1.75B of senior notes due 2032 and 2035 (closed 29 April 2025); proceeds were mainly to redeem its 2027 notes and unwind related swaps. On 3 April 2026 Micron prepaid most of both series ($1.46B of principal), leaving $291M outstanding.
summary_zh: 美光发行 17.5 亿美元 2032 年及 2035 年到期优先票据（2025 年 4 月 29 日交割），所得主要用于赎回 2027 年到期票据及结清相关利率互换。2026 年 4 月 3 日美光提前偿还了两期票据的大部分（本金 14.6 亿美元），剩余 2.91 亿美元未偿。

amount_text: $2B zero-coupon bonds due March 2032, exchangeable into Trip.com Hong Kong shares
title_en: Baidu $2B exchangeable bonds into Trip.com
title_zh: 百度 20 亿美元可交换债（可换携程股份）
summary_en: Baidu sold $2B of zero-coupon bonds exchangeable into Trip.com shares, with proceeds to repay debt, pay interest and for general corporate purposes. The deal closed on 12 March 2025.
summary_zh: 百度发行 20 亿美元零息可交换债券（可交换为携程港股），所得款项用于偿债、付息及一般公司用途，2025 年 3 月 12 日交割。

title_en: Baidu CNY 10B dim sum bonds
title_zh: 百度 100 亿元离岸人民币债券
summary_en: Baidu raised CNY 10B in offshore yuan notes, its first bond sale since 2021, ahead of a $600M security due in April.
summary_zh: 百度发行 100 亿元离岸人民币债券，为 2021 年以来首次发债，并在 4 月一笔 6 亿美元债券到期前完成。

amount_text: $2.3B construction loan for phase 1 (206 MW)
title_en: JPMorgan $2.3B loan for Abilene Stargate phase 1
title_zh: 摩根大通为阿比林星际之门一期提供 23 亿美元贷款
summary_en: JPMorgan lent $2.3B to the Crusoe / Blue Owl / Primary Digital joint venture building the first 206 MW of the Abilene, Texas campus, fully leased to Oracle and used for OpenAI (the first Stargate site). Borrower is the JV in which Crusoe is developer.
summary_zh: 摩根大通向 Crusoe、Blue Owl 与 Primary Digital 的合资公司提供 23 亿美元贷款，用于建设得州阿比林园区首期 206 兆瓦，园区由甲骨文整体承租、供 OpenAI 使用（星际之门首个站点）。借款方为 Crusoe 担任开发商的合资公司。

title_en: Broadcom $3B bond sale (January 2025)
title_zh: 博通发行 30 亿美元债券（2025 年 1 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold $3B of senior notes in three tranches to prepay part of its VMware term loans.
summary_zh: 博通发行三档共 30 亿美元优先票据，用于提前偿还部分 VMware 定期贷款。

subkind: senior unsecured notes (USD and offshore CNY)
amount_text: $2.65B USD notes ($1B 2030, $1.15B 2035, $0.5B 2054) + CNY 17B (~$2.35B) offshore yuan notes, maturities 2028-2044
title_en: Alibaba $5B dual-currency bond sale
title_zh: 阿里巴巴约 50 亿美元双币种债券
summary_en: Alibaba priced $2.65B of US dollar notes and CNY 17B of offshore yuan notes, about $5B in total, for general corporate purposes including repaying offshore debt and share buybacks. Both closed by 28 November 2024.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴定价发行 26.5 亿美元的美元票据及 170 亿元离岸人民币票据，合计约 50 亿美元，用于偿还离岸债务、股份回购等一般公司用途，两部分均于 2024 年 11 月 28 日前交割。

amount_text: $5B of loans in the finalised CHIPS award (alongside $6.6B of grants, not counted here); amount drawn not disclosed
title_en: US CHIPS award gives TSMC Arizona $5B of loans
title_zh: 美国芯片法案向台积电亚利桑那提供 50 亿美元贷款
summary_en: The Commerce Department finalised TSMC's CHIPS award for its Arizona fabs: $6.6B of grants plus $5B in loans. The loans are counted here; the grants are not debt.
summary_zh: 美国商务部敲定台积电亚利桑那工厂的芯片法案支持：66 亿美元补贴，外加 50 亿美元贷款。此处仅计入贷款，补贴不属于债务。

amount_text: $4B, undrawn at closing; JPMorgan, Citi, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, Santander, Wells Fargo, SMBC, UBS, HSBC
title_en: OpenAI $4B revolving credit facility
title_zh: OpenAI 40 亿美元循环信贷额度
summary_en: OpenAI set up a $4B revolver with nine banks alongside its $6.6B equity round, giving it over $10B of liquidity to buy compute.
summary_zh: OpenAI 在 66 亿美元股权融资同时与九家银行设立 40 亿美元循环信贷额度，使其可用于购买算力的流动性超过 100 亿美元。

amount_text: $10.8B from about 18-20 international and Chinese banks; half term loan, half revolver; three years plus a two-year extension option
title_en: ByteDance $10.8B offshore syndicated loan
title_zh: 字节跳动 108 亿美元境外银团贷款
summary_en: ByteDance set up a $10.8B offshore loan with Chinese and international banks, reported as the largest dollar corporate loan in Asia outside Japan. Part of it retired a $5B loan from 2021; Citigroup, Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan coordinated.
summary_zh: 字节跳动与中资及国际银行签署 108 亿美元境外贷款，据报道是日本以外亚洲规模最大的美元公司贷款，其中部分用于偿还 2021 年的 50 亿美元贷款，花旗、高盛和摩根大通为统筹行。

amount_text: $5B in four tranches (notes due 2028-2034); priced 26 Sep, settled 2 Oct 2024; to prepay term loans
title_en: Broadcom $5B bond sale (September 2024)
title_zh: 博通发行 50 亿美元债券（2024 年 9 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold a further $5B of senior notes in four tranches after the Fed's rate cut, using the proceeds to prepay VMware-related term loans.
summary_zh: 博通在美联储降息后再发行四档共 50 亿美元优先票据，所得用于提前偿还与 VMware 相关的定期贷款。

amount_text: $5B in three tranches (notes due 2027, 2029, 2031); to prepay VMware acquisition term loans
title_en: Broadcom $5B bond sale (July 2024)
title_zh: 博通发行 50 亿美元债券（2024 年 7 月）
summary_en: Broadcom sold $5B of investment-grade bonds in three parts, led by BofA, BNP Paribas and HSBC, to repay part of the loans that funded its VMware purchase.
summary_zh: 博通发行三档共 50 亿美元投资级债券，由美国银行、法国巴黎银行和汇丰牵头，用于偿还收购 VMware 的部分贷款。

amount_text: $5B of 0.50% convertible notes due 2031 ($4.5B base + $0.5B option exercised)
title_en: Alibaba $5B convertible notes
title_zh: 阿里巴巴 50 亿美元可转换票据
summary_en: Alibaba sold $5B of 0.50% convertible senior notes due 2031 ($4.5B base plus a $0.5B option), with proceeds mainly for capped call transactions and share buybacks.
summary_zh: 阿里巴巴发行 50 亿美元、票息 0.50%、2031 年到期的可转换优先票据（基础 45 亿美元加 5 亿美元超额配售选择权），资金主要用于上限看涨期权交易和股份回购。

amount_text: Up to $7.5B; led by Blackstone funds, Magnetar co-lead; Coatue, Carlyle, CDPQ, DigitalBridge, BlackRock and others
title_en: CoreWeave $7.5B debt facility led by Blackstone
title_zh: 黑石牵头向 CoreWeave 提供 75 亿美元债务融资
summary_en: In one of the largest private-credit financings of its kind, Blackstone and Magnetar led up to $7.5B of GPU-backed debt so CoreWeave could build compute for existing contracts with AI developers and enterprises.
summary_zh: 同类最大规模私募信贷之一：黑石与 Magnetar 牵头提供最高 75 亿美元 GPU 抵押债务，供 CoreWeave 为与 AI 实验室及企业的现有合同建设算力。

amount_text: $1.5B: $500M 3-year and $1B 5-year notes (day of pricing about 9 Jan 2024)
title_en: SK hynix $1.5B dollar bond sale
title_zh: SK 海力士发行 15 亿美元美元债
summary_en: SK hynix raised $1.5B in dollar bonds: $500M of three-year notes at 145 bp over Treasuries and $1B of five-year notes at 167 bp, amid strong demand.
summary_zh: SK 海力士发行 15 亿美元美元债：5 亿美元三年期（较美债利差 145 个基点）和 10 亿美元五年期（利差 167 个基点），需求旺盛。

amount_text: $2.3B; co-led by Magnetar and Blackstone, with Coatue, DigitalBridge, BlackRock, PIMCO, Carlyle
title_en: CoreWeave $2.3B GPU-backed loan (Magnetar, Blackstone)
title_zh: CoreWeave 获 23 亿美元 GPU 抵押贷款（Magnetar、黑石牵头）
summary_en: CoreWeave's first big GPU-backed private-credit facility, led by Magnetar and Blackstone, used to buy hardware for already-signed customer contracts.
summary_zh: CoreWeave 首笔大型 GPU 抵押私募信贷融资，由 Magnetar 和黑石牵头，用于为已签约客户合同采购硬件。
